symptom: The merge an ON ERROR handler falls through to was stored on top of the next node: `@position(240,200) call … on error without rollback {…}; @position(560,200) return;` gave ExclusiveMerge 560;200 40x40 and EndEvent 560;200 20x20. With an activity after the guarded one, the merge landed RIGHT of that activity and the edge into it ran backwards. Moving the RETURN moved both.
cause: addErrorHandlerRejoinFlowForState (and the empty-handler variant, and mergeOverConnectedEndEvents) placed the merge at fb.posX - HorizontalSpacing/2, Y fb.baseY. The rejoin is wired after addStatement(next), when the cursor has already moved past the successor (an end event advances it by spacing/2, an activity by a full spacing), and baseY is never updated inside an IF branch
file: mdl/executor/cmd_microflows_builder_flows.go (mergeOnEdge, objectByID, the two rejoin sites, mergeOverConnectedEndEvents)
insight: The issue's 'make @merge work on ON ERROR' half was already done (#750: finishCustomErrorHandler reads @merge into rejoinMergeAt); the real defect was the default. Place the merge from the two nodes it sits between — midway between the origin's right edge and the destination's left edge, on the destination's line — and keep the cursor formula only for an edge that does not run left to right (a row wrap). With default spacing the 40px merge exactly fills the 40px gap between two activities: no overlap, no daylight; widening the gap would shift every downstream node and needs the measurer to agree. CALL WEB SERVICE still bypasses finishCustomErrorHandler, so @merge is ignored there. Verified on PedApp 11.13.0: main 560;200 (on the end event), fixed 425;200.
